POST /zones/{zone_id}/content-upload-sca.description: Enable Content Scanning for a zone, so that Cloudflare inspects content objects uploaded to the zone and checks them for malware. Scan results populate the `cf.waf.content_scan.*` fields, which you can reference in custom rules and rate limiting rules.

POST /zones/{zone_id}/content-upload-sca.summary: Create Content Scanning custom expressions for a zone.
POST /zones/{zone_id}/content-upload-sca.description: Create one or more Content Scanning custom expressions, appending them to the existing list of the zone, and return the updated list.
